tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid nying rje gcig gyur pas/ /gzung 'dzin kun rtog mthar byed pa'i/ /gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /re shig 'dir dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ dur khrod la sogs par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir gshin rje gshed sgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar por dmigs pa'i dpral bar pad+ma dang zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa dang snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma la āḥyig dmar po dang hūm̐ yig sngon po bsgom zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdag bsrung / oṃ badz+ra ā sa na hūm̐/ zhes pas stan rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang gi snying gar oṃ dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dmar po las byung ba'i dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can/ mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ kha dog dmar po'i 'od zer gyis/ gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na maḥshrī gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag 'tshal zhing snying kha'i hūm̐ yig las 'thon pa'i me tog ma la sogs pas mchod par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes kun la sbyar la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/

badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid stsal dang / /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de dag mgon la lan gsum bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags pa'i dge tshogs rjes yi rang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs kyi mchog bcas skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho de rnams la/ /bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston pa yi/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes las bzhugs gyur cig /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras lam gyur sbyin tshogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dwang bas bsten par gyis/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo 'o/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyi/ /zhes bdun rnam dag dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis sdom pa gzung nas/ tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig dgra gnyen la nye ring med pa'i btang snyoms par gyur cig snyam du tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ zhes pas gzung ba'i yul rang bzhin med pa dang / oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rang rig pa tsam dang / oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rang rig pa'i rang bzhin med par mos par bya'o/

/de nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis/ sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig tu gyur pa las/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma la sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du/ pad zla la gnas shing / saṃ yig las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum gyi phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa bsam mo/ /de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pas/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab gra bzhi pa rin po che'i bang rim gyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang nag pa'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pas steng na rin po che'i snam bu dang / de'i steng na bya 'dabs nas dpyangs pa'i rin chen shar bu dang / drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ steng du pad+ma'i rtse mo'i dbyibs can gyi kra ma shir ṣas mdzes par byas la/ sgo'i mdun du ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos mtshan pa/ gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / dar dpyang dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan cing / phyi rol gyi kha khyer la lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du mas mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/

kha khyer nas rdo rje ra ba'i bar gyi sa gzhi la/ rin chen sna bdun dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i yo byad du ma dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs du mas gang ba/ 'og gzhi dang steng gi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang dbus su thing kha/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can/ dbus rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte ba dang / phyogs kyi rwa bzhi'i rtsa bar pad ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje dang mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros khams gsum gang / sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs su byas/ slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dmar po nyin mor byed pa bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ g.yon bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / g.yas na 'jig rten gsum las rgyal bar byed pa'i dbyug pa dkar po bsnams pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ mtha' yas sngon pos dbu/ 'jog po dmar pos rna ba/ rigs ldan khra bos sna/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub/ pad+ma dkar pos do shal/ kar ko ṭa sngon pos se ral kha/ nor rgyas dkar pos ska rags/ pad ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ zhal cung zad bye zhing drag po'i rnam 'gyur gyis bzhad pa/ ljags 'dril ba nyi ma lta bu'i spyin gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ khro gnyer can gsus pa dang brla dang brang che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku yan lag dang nying lag thung zhing sma ra dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'jigs pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ ma he dmar nag gi steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing /

gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad bskrag par byed pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba/ phyag g.yon na bdud kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / g.yas na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan cha lugs gtso dang mthun pa'o/ /de bzhin du shar gyi 'dab mar gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po/ tsār tsi ka nag mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ lho'i 'dab mar ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po phag mo ser mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ byang gi 'dab mar phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu gau rī sngon mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ dpa' bo rnams rgyan cha lugs gtso dang mthun zhing / dpa' mo rnams gtso mo dang mthun pa'o/ /me mtshams su mu men gser tshab kyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ bden bral du gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ rlung du byu ru'i bum pa sih+las gang ba/ dbang ldan du dngul gyi bum pa ga pur gyis gang ba ste/ de rnams kyang thod pas kha brgyan pa'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbyug pa dkar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ dmar pos mtshan pa bsam mo/ /de nas yab yum gyi mkha' hūm̐ dang a las byung ba'i rdo rje dang pad ma bsam ste snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing / o+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang thod pa can dang / mgrin par āḥlas pad ma āḥs mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po pad ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa bsam/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams spyan drangs nas gnas gsum du thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga yab yum nam mkhar spyan drangs nas sngar bzhin mchod de/ oṃ ā bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing rin po ches spras pa'i gser gyur gyi bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas dbang bskur zhing / bkra shis kyi glu dang / gur gum la sogs pa'i char dang / rnga bo che la sogs pa'i sgra dang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam mo/ /de nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ dpa' bo bzhi la gtso bo/ yum la rang rang gi yab kyis dbur brgyan par bsgom mo/ /de nas snying ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags phreng 'bar bas bskor bar bltas la/ yid kyis klog pa'i bsam pas gtso bo la/ /oṃ hrīṣ+ṭ+rī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po dang / oṃ hau k+ṣau k+ṣaṃ yaṃ ka ra gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ mahā yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ye ma ha dur dān+ta dā ma ka la/ nā ga ya nā sha ya/

bi dra ba ya bi dra ba ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa'i phreng ba'i sngags dang / oṃ dwa ṣa ra ti/ nu da nu da/ ṭu ṭa ṭu ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes rje btsun ma'i sngags bzlas shing / dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams la'ang rang gi thugs kar sa bon las sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ mo ha an ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pi shu na an ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rā ga an ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ir+ṣ+ya an+ta kṛ t hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dpa' bo dang / oṃ mo ha ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ.oṃ pi shu na ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ.oṃ ir ṣ+ya ra ti hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dpa' mo bzhi'i sngags bzlas so/ /de nas thun mtshams kyis rnal 'byor ni/ mchod rdzas rnams hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīs bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ aṃ las skyes pa'i thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyis mchod cing / mchod pa dang zhing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' khyab par bskyed nas so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang 'dra'i mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab nas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yis/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul lo/ /ci bder bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul ba/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /lha rdzas 'bar ba mun sel ba'i/ /zhun mar til mar sgron ma 'di/ /mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /bza' ba ston mo mnyam ldan zhing /

/kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces sogs dang / sngar bshad pa'i so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod la/ de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phyogs skyong la sogs pa rnams la mchod la/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin yongs/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa khro bo'i yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku ni dmar zhing thung bas te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul can/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma bdud tshe/ /gar mdzad bde ba chen po khyod/ /hrīḥṣ+ṭ+wī'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /snying rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba rnams la gzigs/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 'jigs rung gshin rje gshed/ sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 'jigs rung bshin rje gshed/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /las kun byed pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab 'bar ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/

/zhes pas bstod de/ de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma sngar ltar bsang sbyangs nas/ nam mkha' pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ mtha' gnyis su rgyal mtshan dkar po brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ dmar po las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum la raṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ru gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a yig dmar po las skyes pa'i pad ma'i snod 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma dang dbus su bh+ruṃ aṃ dzīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams dang dbus su lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ bāṃ/ rnams yongs su gyur pa las sha lnga/ go ku da ha na dang / bi ra shu ma mūs mtshan par blta'o/ /de'i steng du oṃ dmar po/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po las dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa sgom ste/ rlung bskyod me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu bar gyur pa'i nang du/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa zhu bas nyi ma 'char kha'i mdog dang / dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur bsam mo/ /de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ lta ste/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi blangs te bkug pas bsil zhing sbrang rtsi 'dus pa'i gzugs lta bu kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par bsams nas/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ rang gi snying ka nas khro bo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa spros nas phyogs skyong bcu'i snying lcags kyus phug mgul pa zhags pas bcings nas bkug par bsams te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ duṣ+ṭa in+d+ra sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas shar du brgya byin dkar ser g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon sdigs mdzub can glang po che la zhon pa/ de bzhin du in+d+ra'i gnas su u pen dra zhes pas de'i g.yon du nye dbang nag po nam mkha' lding la gnas pa rin po che'i cod pan/ g.yas na be con dang g.yon na dung dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ lhor ya ma zhes pas gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa/ dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ nub tu ba ru ṇa zhes pas chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ ku be ra zhes pas byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa g.yas na bī dza pū ra/ g.yon na ne'u le 'dzin pa/ ga ṇa pa ti zhes pas de'i g.yon du tshogs bdag dkar po bgrang phreng dang dgra sta/ g.yon du phug dang la du 'dzin pa/ ā shi na zhes pas dbang ldan du dbang phyug chen po dkar po khyu mchog la gnas pa/ g.yas g.yon dang pos rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gau rī la 'khyud pa/ ag+ni zhes pas shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rak+ṣa sa zhes pas bden bral du srin po sngo nag ro langs la zhon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ bā yu zhes pas rlung du rlung lha du mdog ri dwags ser po la zhon pa/ rlung ras 'dzin pa/ tsan+d+ra zhes pas de'i g.yon du zla ba dkar po shing rta la gnas pa ku mu da 'dzin pa/ arka zhes pas steng du nyi ma dmar po rta bdun la gnas pa pad ma 'dzin pa/ brah+ma zhes pas de dag gi steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa gdong bzhi pa phyag bzhi spyi blugs dang / mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ pṛ thi wī de wī zhes pas 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad ma la gnas pa/ g.yon pa bum pa dang g.yas pas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya can dang / bai ma tsi tri ṇa zhes pas de'i g.yon du thag bzangs ris sngon po rta la gnas pa/ ral gri dang sdigs mdzub can rnams bzhag cing / de dag gi mtha' skor du sems can thams cad bsam mo/

/de nas snying ka'i 'od kyis gshin rje mthar byed kyi gzugs tho ba dang phur bu 'dzin pas bkug ste de rnams kyis phyogs skyong bcu'i spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying ka dang rkang pa'i mthar phur bus gdab par bsam mo/ /oṃ hṝḥṣ+ṭ+rī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṇa in+d+ra di sa pa ri wā rān kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas gnod sems dang bral nas thig le'i bdag nyid du zhu bar bsam mo/ /de gyur pa las thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed de/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rigs bdag gshin rjegashed kyis rgyas btab par bsam ste/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta sha rī rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta maṇ+ḍa la bha ra ṇa ya/ rak+ta ra tha sa ma tu ḍhā ya/ rak+ta pad+ma sa nā ya/ rak+ta bha ra ṇā ya/ i daṃ? ba li gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma bigh+nāṃ ha ra ha ra tsa tur mā rān ni ba ra ya ni bā ra ya bzlog trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ tshin dha tshin dha/ bhin dha bhin dha/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tshe da ts+tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas dbul zhing / phyogs skyong rnams la yang / oṃ in+d+ra ya na maḥ bigh+naḥhriḥ ya mā ya na maḥ ṣ+ṭ+rīḥ wa ru ṇā ya na maḥ bi/ ku be rā ya na maḥkṛ/ ī sha nā ya na maḥta/ ag+na ye na maḥn/ bā ya be na maḥn/ tsan+d+ra ya na maḥhūm̐/ arkā ya na maḥhūm̐/ brah+ma ṇe na maḥphaṭ/ ba sun dha rā yai na maḥphaṭ/ bai ma tsi tri ṇe na maḥswa/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥhā/ ha ha ha hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swāhā/ zhes pas dbul zhing / yum bzhi la'ang / oṃ marme/ marma bi ga te hūm̐/ badz+ra tsar tsi ka ha ra ha ra/ bu+uṃk+kamā ra ya a mu kaṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ

oṃ gho ne su gho ne/ badz+ra mā ma kī/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ a mu kaṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ marme marma k+ṣo bha ṇi/ badz+ra sa ra swa ti da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ kam+pa kam+pa/ dhu na dhu na/ hūm̐ aḥ mu ki hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gaṃ bhī ra/ badz+rakārti ka/ gha gha hūm̐/ rak+ṣa sho ni ta pri ye/ gau rī ye a mu kaṃ hūm̐ dzaḥzhes pas phul la sngar bzhin bstod pas bstod nas 'dod don gsol te/ hā hā he he ho ho hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ thun mtshams su dag pa rjes su dran pa bya ba ni/ sku mdog dmar po 'dod chags dag pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i spyan gsum/ dngos po dngos med kyi rtog pa 'joms pas phyag gnyis/ stong pa snying rje tha mi dad pas yum dang sbyor ba/ rnam shes brgyad dag pas klu brgyad/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo lnga bcu/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i thod dbyug khams gsum la chags pa g.yon brkyang gi gom stabs/ ro bcud du ma kun nas myang ba dang / rnam rtog gcod pas yum gyi thod pa dang gri gug gdug pa 'dul bas khro bo'i gzugs/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bas gsus pa che ba/ bden bzhi ston pas skra gyen du brdzes pa dang / yab lnga ye shes lnga/ yum bzhi tshad med bzhi/ bcom ldan 'das ma nam mkha'i khams dag pa'o/ /thod pa dang bcas pa'i bum pa bzhin/ 'dod pa'i yon tan dang / dga' ba bzhi dang phrin las bzhi dang / bde ba chen po'i ngo bo zhes dang / gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dag pa'o/ /zhes dran par bya ste/ snod bcud de'i ngo bor blta'o/ /gzhan kha zas spyod lam/ nyal ba ldang ba khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams gzhan bzhin no/ /mthu stobs rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsung / /rgyud dang man ngag ji bzhin du/ /gshin rje mthar byed sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bris pa'i dge bas de thob shog
